title: Cow waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='63' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='72' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='60' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='58' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='70' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='70' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='44' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='38' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='36' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0c0c8'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='50' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f0b8c0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='11' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#c07a88'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#c07a88'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='42' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M20 32 Q18 24 22 22' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M31 31 Q34 24 30 21' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M74 62 Q86 54 88 40' stroke='#f5f5f5' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hoof on waving hand -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <!-- motion lines -->
  <path d='M81 32 Q84 30 87 31' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 40 Q83 39 86 41' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 72 Q86 74 84 84' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='85' r='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
</svg>
